data.one_liner: An animated, highly customizable Flutter radial gauge widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated radial gauges with customizable pointers, progress bars, zones, gradients, and labels via a Flutter widget. Supports custom sweep degrees, origins, and zone styling.
use_when: You need to display a radial gauge, progress ring, or speedometer in your Flutter app.
You require smooth animations when gauge values change.
avoid_when: You need complex cartesian, bar, line, or pie charts instead of gauges.
You need an imperative API for manual canvas drawing.
strengths: Highly customizable with opt-in pointers, zones, gradients, and labels
Supports smooth value animations out of the box
Zero transitive dependencies like equatable or collection
weaknesses: Must be sized by its parent widget

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_gauges
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you need an enterprise-grade gauge library with a massive set of built-in indicator types, dials, and extensive enterprise support.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose it if you need a comprehensive charting solution that includes line, bar, pie, and scatter charts alongside basic indicators.

data.minimal_example:
SizedBox(
